duration: 5 min para entregar os itens (mais o tempo para os juntar e fazer a First Dragon Quest)
summary: O {wiki:Festive Outfits|Festive Outfit} obtém-se na {wiki:First Dragon Quest|First Dragon Quest}. Depois, o {npc:Muriel}, em Thais, dá-te os dois addons: o primeiro em troca de 3 {item:Porcelain Mask|Porcelain Masks} e o segundo em troca de 50 {item:Colourful Feathers}.
requirements: Ter o Festive Outfit, obtido na {wiki:First Dragon Quest|First Dragon Quest}.

rewards.text: Primeiro e segundo addons do Festive Outfit

tips: Podes pedir os dois addons pela ordem que quiseres: o Muriel pergunta qual dos dois estás a entregar.

steps.title: Fazer a First Dragon Quest
steps.text: O Festive Outfit é obtido na {wiki:First Dragon Quest|First Dragon Quest}, onde enfrentas {creature:The First Dragon}. Completa-a primeiro.

steps.title: Entregar 3 Porcelain Masks
steps.text: Leva 3 {item:Porcelain Mask|Porcelain Masks} ao {npc:Muriel}, em **Thais**. Diz {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} e {key:mask}.

dialogue.npc: Greetings! Looking for wisdom and power, eh?
Are you interested in one or two addons to a beautiful festive outfit?
I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me three porcelain masks. For the second addon you need fifty colourful ostrich feathers. Do you want one of these addons?
What do you have for me: the porcelain masks or the colourful feathers?
Very good! You gained the first addon to the festive outfit.
Are you interested in one or two addons to a beautiful festive outfit?
What do you have for me: the porcelain masks or the colourful feathers?
Very good! You gained the second addon to the festive outfit.
